annotations.title: Prepare card price updates for confirmation

description: Prepare exact one-time price changes for the connected owner's RAW, graded, or all cards using market pricing and existing price limits. Requires store:prices:write consent. Show each listing, old price and proposed price to the user and ask for explicit confirmation before apply_card_price_updates. Returns signed approvals valid for ten minutes. Does not enable automation or publish listings.

cardType.description: Review RAW, graded/authenticated, or all active in-stock card copies in the connected store.

cursor.description: Continue with nextCursor from the previous page, keeping the same selection.

direction.description: Filter one-time price changes. Ongoing repricing requires ANY; publishing includes all displayed cards.

strategy.description: AT_MARKET, PREMIUM (above market), or MOVE_FAST. Omit to use the existing store strategy. Confirmed automation uses this as store-wide strategy.

name: prepare_card_price_updates
